triples.evidence: Started 17 Oct 2026 by the University scale thread.
A model writes X3D (system prompt: DSPy no-Full rule pack).
The exact validator (fork d5598c4 or newer) says what is wrong; the model repairs.
A real browser render (X_ITE 16.5.1) says whether anything is in view.
Blender owns the look (Cycles), X3D stays master for behaviour and provenance
New valid-but-invisible class: real place names. All 16 scenes added Geospatial nodes because the brief named Blacksburg; 4 of 16 wrapped the whole building in GeoLocation

loops.name: X3D AI flywheel loop
loops.evidence:
1. A model writes X3D (system prompt: DSPy no-Full rule pack).
2. The exact validator (fork d5598c4 or newer) says what is wrong; the model repairs.
3. A real browser render (X_ITE 16.5.1) says whether anything is in view.
4. Vision judges... say whether it looks like the target.
5. Blender owns the look (Cycles)...
6. What the judges and renders catch that the validator does not becomes a new validator rule or prompt rule.
